translation.name: New Testament in the Yaka language (Congo-Brazzaville)

content: Bakaa ba Yiisu
Wu ni mukaanda a makuumbu ma bakaa ba Yiisu Kristo, mwaana a Daavidi, mwaana a Abraami.
Isaki mwaana a Abraami; Yaakobi mwaana a Isaki; Yuuda na baana banguu ba nde, baana ba Yaakobi.
Peresi na Zeera baana ba Yuuda. Nguu a bo ali Tamare; Eseroni mwaana a Peresi, na Arami mwaana a Eseroni.
Aminadabi mwaana a Arami; Nasoni mwaana a Aminadabi, Salamoni mwaana a Naasoni.
Booze mwaana a Salamoni; na Laabi ali nguu a Booze. Obedi mwaana a Booze, na nguu a Obedi ali Luta. Yeese mwaana a Obedi.
Mutini Daavidi mwaana a Yeese. Salomo mwaana a Daavidi. Nguu a nde ali mukari a Uuli.
Loboami mwaana a Salomo; Abia mwaana a Loboami; Azafi mwaana a Abia;
Yosafate mwaana a Azafi; Yorami mwaana a Yosafate; Ozia mwaana a Yorami;
Yotami mwaana Ozia; Akazi mwaana a Yotami; Ezekiase mwaana a Akazi;
Manase mwaana a Ezekiase; Amoni mwaana a Manase; Yosia mwaana a Amoni;
Yekonya na baana ba nguu ba nde, baana ba Yosia, mu taanga di babiti baana ba Iseraeli mu bukori ku ngaanda a Babilooni.
Nha mbisi a nha babiti baana ba Iseraeli mu bukori ku ngaanda a Babilooni, Selatieli mwaana a Yekonya, na Zorobabeeli mwaana a Salatieeli.
Abiyudi mwaana a Zorobabeeli; Eliyakimi mwaana a Abiyudi; Azori mwaana a Eliyakimi.
Sadoki mwaana a Azori; Akimi mwaana a Sadoki; Eliyudi mwaana a Akimi.
Eleazari mwaana a Eliyudi; Matani mwaana a Eleazari; Yaakobi mwaana a Matani.
Yoosefi mwaana a Yaakobi; ni Yoosefi me wuu, mulumi a Mari, wuli nguu a Yiisu wu bali mu uta Kristo.

Litaanga la bisieende bioosi, umatuu mu Abraami natee mu taanga dia Daavidi ali kuumi na bina. Tumake, kuumi na bina umatuu mu taanga dia Daavidi, natee bu babiti baana ba Iseraeli mu bukori ku Babilooni. Na kuumi na bina, umatuu bu babiti baana ba Iseraeli ku Babilooni natee mu taanga dia mbutili a Kristo.
Mbutili a Yiisu
Mono bwali mbutili a Yiisu Kristo. Mari, nguu a nde, ali na lilasina la makweele na Yoosefi. Ka tswaamini ti bo budiaala itwaari, Mari abayi yimi mu litu la Muheebili wa Ngira.
Yoosefi wali mulumi a nde, ali muutu wasuungunu. Na bu nde ali a atoono pe umweese Mari tsionyi nha kulu a baata, Yoosefi aholi kesili ya ukabuu na nde mu tsweeyi.
Bu nde akitsimi ndaa yii, tumu a Pfumu wamumonii mu nziori, wamuleeli: «Yoosefi, mwaana a Daavidi, a ba na boomo mu ukweele Mari pe, mundaa ti mu litu la Muheebili wa Ngira nde abayi yimi lii.
Mari sa abutu mwaana wa baala, wu we kaaha kuumbu Yiisu, ka mwaana wuu sa avuusu baata ba nde mu masumu ma bo.»
Maa moosi mayilimi, paa ti maleeli Pfumu mu mubili, mayene tsitsi:

content.text: na sa abutu mwaana wa baala,

content: Mbiindili a kuumbu yii: «Nziaambi li na bisi».
Yoosefi bu asiimbii, ayilii weti bwamutumi tumu a Pfumu, na nde aholi Mari mu uba mukari a nde.
Ka nde a avuuti mbuu na mukari pe, natee bu Mari abuti mwaana a nde wa baala, wu Yoosefi ahi kuumbu Yiisu.

footnotes.text: 1.23 Nduumbu wu keni a avuutu nyutu na baala pe.
